probe_detail.name: A specific concrete detail carries the joke
Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
Extent of capitalised or shouted typography
Sets up an expectation and then turns it

final.name: Engages the prompt's specific conceit, not just its category
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the entry engages the prompt's specific qualifier versus its generic category, a genuine content/craft judgment about the joke itself.

final.name: Truncation residue: fragment, dangling colon, mid-sentence stop
final.audit_justification: Scores a textual completeness/truncation fingerprint (dangling colon, mid-sentence stop) and explicitly forbids judging wit, so it is a production-artifact marker, not craft.
final.upstream_parent: corpus extraction and segmentation - how the archived contest column was split into per-entry records

final.name: Full multi-line structural completion, not a fragment
final.audit_justification: Requires internally consistent execution of the full form (meter, rhyme, narrative arc), a genuine craft/skill judgment, not just a completeness check.

final.name: Reference as comic machinery
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a reference actively generates the joke's meaning versus being a decorative name-drop, a content/craft distinction.

final.name: High semantic compression
final.audit_justification: Judges whether each word carries a distinct layer of comic content, a genuine craft judgment about economy and density, not raw length.

final.name: Self-contained logical or lexical riddle operation
final.audit_justification: Judges the elegance and self-containment of a logical/lexical operation that constitutes the joke, a craft judgment.

final.name: Entry text is complete, not cut off mid-thought
final.audit_justification: Purely checks whether the text is cut off mid-sentence/mid-clause, a completeness/production fingerprint with no craft component.
final.arbiter_reason: The criterion scores whether the stored text happens to be truncated, which is a fingerprint of how the item was captured and stored rather than of the entrant's craft; no part of the instruction inspects wit, aptness, or construction. The proposer's own evidence shows truncated items on both the dense-high and card-high sides, so completeness does not track quality even directionally and does not warrant a mixed flag.

final.name: Non-Arbitrary Concept Bridge
final.audit_justification: Judges whether disparate ideas are joined by a discoverable, exact relationship versus mere juxtaposition, a craft judgment about construction.

final.name: In-text irregularity reads as clearly intentional, not noise
final.audit_justification: Judges whether an irregularity is unambiguously signaled as a deliberate, load-bearing joke device rather than noise, which evaluates execution/clarity of the comic mechanism.

final.name: Title-only compression
final.audit_justification: Scores mere shortness/title-form of the entry while explicitly barring judgment of whether the brevity is clever, a length/format marker.

final.name: Entry breaks frame to comment on itself or the contest
final.audit_justification: Judges whether meta-commentary on the contest itself succeeds as humor, a content/craft judgment about the joke.

final.name: Prompt-Form Fusion
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the required form actively creates the joke's timing/meaning versus being interchangeable, a craft judgment about form-content fusion.

final.name: Convergent attribution: multiple independent entrants credited
final.audit_justification: Counts how many entrants are jointly credited and explicitly forbids inferring merit from it, an attribution/venue-process marker.
final.upstream_parent: independent co-discovery - how many entrants arrived at the same idea, i.e. how obvious the idea was given the prompt

final.name: Orthographic and encoding anomalies
final.audit_justification: Counts misspellings, malformed characters, and encoding corruption while barring judgment of whether they help or hurt, an orthographic/data-artifact marker.

final.name: Late-riff residue
final.audit_justification: Scores a self-referential/defensive-riff textual signature explicitly framed as a position-in-the-run fingerprint rather than an originality judgment, though a veteran entrant's later, more reactive style could plausibly also be genuinely sharper writing.
final.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream / submission timing

final.name: Trailing parenthetical attribution block present and long
final.audit_justification: Scores the size of a trailing name-and-city attribution block while explicitly forbidding any influence on the reading of the joke, a pure attribution-formatting marker.
final.upstream_parent: corpus construction and archival formatting - whether the byline survived transcription into the dataset

final.name: Adverbial Semantic Snap
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a quoted statement and its adverb jointly expose a second meaning versus mere decoration, a craft judgment about wordplay.

final.name: Entry's own form embodies or enacts its content
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the entry's form itself enacts the property it describes, a genuine self-reference craft judgment.

final.name: First-obvious-reading of the prompt versus late-arriving riff
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores 'availability of the idea' as a position-in-the-response-space fingerprint and states both obvious and late responses can be equally excellent or terrible, so it is not a quality judgment.
final.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream and submission timing - where in the week's flood of submissions, and how deep into an entrant's own list of attempts, an item was produced

final.name: Construction Beyond Shock
final.audit_justification: Judges whether crude/dark material is transformed by exact wordplay or irony versus shock being the only mechanism, a content/craft judgment.

final.name: Submission-template residue
final.audit_justification: Counts headings, labels, prompt restatements, and scaffolding while barring judgment of formatting appropriateness, a template/boilerplate artifact marker.

final.name: Raw word/token length of the entry text
final.audit_justification: A pure word-count measurement of entry length with explicit instruction not to judge appropriateness, though a more practiced entrant's tendency to write fuller entries could plausibly also mean genuinely better-developed jokes.
final.upstream_parent: entry format/category (some prompts structurally demand short outputs, others long ones) and possible editorial space constraints on how much text a given slot in the print column can hold

final.name: Density of early-1990s news-cycle proper nouns
final.audit_justification: Counts density of era-specific topical proper nouns while explicitly barring judgment of aptness or funniness, a temporal/topical dating marker.
final.upstream_parent: the publication date of the contest and the news cycle running that week

final.name: Stable false logic
final.audit_justification: Judges whether an apparently sensible statement collapses under a precise, coherent contradiction, a craft judgment about joke logic.

final.name: Exact two-reading wordplay
final.audit_justification: Judges whether an altered word supports two clear, related readings versus being a loose pun or plain misspelling, a wordplay-craft judgment.
